name: TACO
tagline: 2,317 sequences / 5.2M frames: 14 people in bimanual tool-object tasks (151 triplets, 206 object meshes); 12 allocentric + 1 ego RGB-D cams.

annotations.format: PKL (MANO hands) + NPY (object poses) + OBJ meshes + MP4/AVI video + JSON camera params
annotations.coverageNote: All 2,317 v1 sequences have MANO hand + 6-DoF tool/target poses and action triplets; ego RGB-D for 2,212; marker-removed allocentric video for 2,120.

action_labels.note: <tool, action, object> triplet per sequence (151 triplets, 15 action types)

segmentation.note: Automatic hand-object 2D segmentation (rendered meshes + SAM / Track-Anything)

hand_pose.note: MANO pose per frame per hand (left/right_hand.pkl) + shape (hand_shape betas)

object_pose.note: 6-DoF tool_<name>.npy / target_<name>.npy per frame + 206 scanned OBJ meshes

camera_pose.note: Allocentric camera intrinsics / extrinsics JSON (12 FLIR cams); ego projection code

depth.note: Egocentric depth video (RealSense L515, 1920x1080 uint16, 0.25 mm units)

annotations.sample:
Hand_Poses/(stir, spoon, bowl)/20231105_019/
  right_hand.pkl         # per-frame MANO params (loaded by mano_params_to_hand_info)
  right_hand_shape.pkl   # {"hand_shape": tensor[10]}  MANO betas
  left_hand.pkl, left_hand_shape.pkl
Object_Poses/(stir, spoon, bowl)/20231105_019/
  tool_<tool_name>.npy, target_<target_name>.npy   # per-frame 6-DoF poses
Object_Models/001_cm.obj ... 218_cm.obj            # scanned meshes, cm units
Egocentric_RGB_Videos/<triplet>/<sequence>/color.mp4
Egocentric_Depth_Videos/<triplet>/<sequence>/egocentric_depth.avi
Allocentric_RGB_Videos/<triplet>/<sequence>/22070938.mp4 ...   # 12 cameras
